entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [Spec] MauiIcon: dark and tinted app icon variants (iOS 18+) #40319
  • [Android] CollectionView ItemSpacing is wrong for items added or removed at runtime #40317
  • [Android][Material3] ActivityIndicator stops animating while the UI thread is busy, so it stalls during page builds #40315
  • [iOS] RefreshView.Background paints the UIRefreshControl instead of the view (opaque band during pull-to-refresh) #40314
  • [iOS] RefreshView leaves the page scrolled under the navigation bar after a pull-to-refresh (stale _originalY) #40313
  • [Android] CollectionView EmptyView: EmptyViewContentView calls requestLayout() during every layout pass #40308
  • [Android][Shell] Handler-based Shell shows a Tab's top tab strip over a pushed page after switching bottom tabs, and the strip stays tappable #40303
  • [Android] MediaPicker.PickPhotoAsync called twice quickly throws "already pending" at the call site and crashes the app from async void #40302
  • dotnet11 maui CollectionView cannot scroll to top after tap status bar on iOS real device #40299
  • [iOS/Mac Catalyst] `LongPressGestureRecognizer.Command` / `LongPressed` fire on release instead of when the press is recognized, and no cross-platform signal exists for "recognized" #40296
  • [aw] Daily Memory Leak Hunter reported incomplete result #40293
  • [iOS 27] RTL pages are shifted into the side status bar on iPhone Duo #40292
  • [Android] Geolocation on API 34+ registers the fused provider as BALANCED, so GPS never turns on (Best/High ignored) #40289
  • [PR Review Queue] 2026-11-16 #40285
  • [net11, Android] Shell assigned to Window.Page while the activity is stopped crashes on resume: FragmentManager is already executing transactions #40279
  • [repo-status] Daily Repo Status — November 16, 2026 🌟 #40278
  • [iOS] ScrollView under a large title jitters when its content barely overflows: ContentSize inflation flips as the title collapses #40277
  • [aw] Daily Memory Leak Hunter is missing required data #40274

Closed

  • Double tapping on tabs makes content of pages disappear #40151
  • [PR Review Queue] 2026-11-12 #40167
  • [repo-status] Daily Repo Status — 2026-11-15 🌟 #40267
